display_name: Zero SR battery CAN (candidate broadcast decode)
notes: Offline passive decoder of Zero SR 29-bit extended-ID battery/ESC broadcasts at 250 kbit/s from the beambreak DBC + notes: 0x0B57ED00 battery version, 0x0B57ED01 serial, 0x0B57ED0F ESC version/serial, 0x0B57ED10 lowest/highest cell V + pack V (LE x0.001), 0x0B57ED14 SoC %, 0x0B57ED1F ESC power control, 0x0B57EDC0 button/BLE-pair; remaining IDs observed-undecoded. Source: rscullin/beambreak CAN Bus/SR_Battery.dbc (no license stated, open per policy; facts reimplemented+cited, DBC not vendored). The upstream battery/ESC EMULATOR (TX) is deliberately NOT implemented. guzzionboard/zero_sr_battery_can.py; synthetic tests only.

session.physical_evidence_note: Broadcast observation only; no diagnostic session implemented.

memory.write_blocked_reason: Broadcast only; no ECU memory access.
